flags.reason: Rested by Arteta for midweek Champions League match vs Napoli (one of four changes, Hincapie started); Arsenal's European schedule creates ongoing rotation risk even when available.

Coming off a long-term injury-hit 2025/26 (ankle/fibula fracture that limited him heavily); although starting and scoring this season, recent player/manager comments emphasise building rhythm and physical condition rather than being fully established.

critic_output.summary: The proposed squad has no acute new injuries, suspensions or active transfer sagas in the last 1-2 weeks, with most players starting regularly. The two watchpoints are Calafiori's midweek rest (typical Arteta rotation with Europe) and Isak still bedding in after last season's lengthy absence. Remaining players such as Saka, Palmer, João Pedro, Thiago, De Cuyper, Tarkowski, Ajayi, Mbeumo, Tavernier, Kelleher, Senesi, Okafor and Roefs have neutral-to-positive availability updates.
